\begin{dpjourney}
\dpstep{1}{Introduction to Graphs}{Degrees and counting $\cdot$ Reachability $\cdot$ Grids as graphs $\cdot$ Implicit state graphs $\cdot$ Functional graphs: one outgoing edge}{Beginner -- 1400}{yes}
\dpstep{2}{Depth-First Search}{Cycle detection and recovery $\cdot$ Subtree aggregation and push-down $\cdot$ Entry and exit times $\cdot$ Backtracking over paths $\cdot$ Reverse search: start from the target}{CF 1000 -- 1900}{yes}
\dpstep{3}{Breadth-First Search}{Shortest paths and reconstruction $\cdot$ Multi-source BFS $\cdot$ Multi-dimensional states $\cdot$ Distances from two ends and second-shortest paths $\cdot$ The shortest-path DAG}{CF 1000 -- 1900}{no}

\dpstep{5}{DAGs \& Topological Sorting}{Ordering with dependencies $\cdot$ Priority and grouped orders $\cdot$ Paths in a DAG $\cdot$ Cycles versus order $\cdot$ Implicit DAGs}{CF 1200 -- 2000}{no}

\dppartgoals{
  \item model any problem as vertices and edges, including grids, numbers, words and game states;
  \item use DFS and BFS fluently: timestamps, cycles, layers, multi-source and state-space search;
  \item decompose graphs into components, bipartite classes and topological orders;
  \item maintain connectivity online with a disjoint-set union, including weighted and offline variants.
}
